# AI-Native Builder Workflow: 4-Step Process for High-Quality Code Generation

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeZqqXvASHs/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** George Wang · **Saved:** 2026-10-13

## Summary

Former FAANG engineer George outlines a 4-step framework for using AI coding agents while maintaining high quality at scale. The process involves pre-implementation planning via PRDs, adversarial code reviews, rubric-based evaluation agents in isolated context windows, and automated end-to-end feedback loops using headless browsers.
